facts.fact: FASUCE, the universal service fund, connected the towns of Miaba and Ehota to the national telecommunications grid, reported by TechAfrica News.
facts.system: FASUCE (Fund for Access and Universal Electronic Communications Service)

facts.fact: FASUCE officially connected two localities, Miaba and Ehota, with inauguration ceremonies attended by the Minister of Posts and Telecommunications.
